title: Kant-Q: A Q-Learning Algorithm for Kantian Equilibrium in Symmetric Markov Games
abstract: arXiv:2611.34536v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents increasingly interact with one another, and many of these interactions are mixed-motive games, which have posed a persistent challenge for learning algorithms. Most multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithms are designed to reach Nash equilibria, yet in many such games these equilibria are Pareto-inefficient. We instead study Kantian equilibria, an economic solution concept in which each agent plays the action it would want all agents to adopt. In symmetric games, this corresponds to an optimal common policy. We propose Kant-Q, a Q-learning algorithm in which each agent learns action profiles where all agents play the same action. Each update is then a sample from a single-agent MDP, so Kant-Q inherits the convergence guarantees of standard Q-learning. We show that every symmetric Markov game has a pure Kantian equilibrium. We also prove that all agents' Q-tables converge to the same limit, whose greedy policy is such

translated_title: Kant-Q：对称马尔可夫博弈中康德均衡的Q学习算法
translated_abstract: AI智能体之间的互动日益增多，其中许多互动属于混合动机博弈，这对学习算法构成了长期挑战。大多数多智能体强化学习（MARL）算法旨在达到纳什均衡，然而在许多此类博弈中，这些均衡是帕累托低效的。我们转而研究康德均衡（Kantian equilibria），这是一种经济学解概念，其中每个智能体采取它希望所有智能体都采用的行动。在对称博弈中，这对应于一个最优的共同策略。我们提出了Kant-Q，这是一种Q学习算法，其中每个智能体学习所有智能体采取相同行动的行动配置。每次更新都是来自单智能体MDP的一个样本，因此Kant-Q继承了标准Q学习的收敛性保证。我们证明每个对称马尔可夫博弈都存在纯策略康德均衡。我们还证明了所有智能体的Q表收敛到相同的极限，其贪心策略是这样一个……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出Kant-Q算法，通过让每个智能体学习所有智能体采取相同行动的行动配置来寻找康德均衡，继承了标准Q学习的收敛保证，并证明每个对称马尔可夫博弈都存在纯策略康德均衡，为解决混合动机博弈中纳什均衡帕累托低效的问题提供了新方案。
en_tdlr: We propose Kant-Q, a Q-learning algorithm that learns Kantian equilibria by having each agent learn action profiles where all agents play the same action, inheriting convergence guarantees from standard Q-learning and proving that every symmetric Markov game has a pure Kantian equilibrium, offering a solution to the Pareto-inefficiency of Nash equilibria in mixed-motive games.
